messages:
Ava (Marketing): Quick sync — draft of the product launch blog is here: https://docs.google.com/draft (comments open). Need quick passes today: hero claim, benchmark framing, CTAs, and inbound routing for webinar signups. Can we lock by EOD?

Priya (Product): skimmed and left a few inline comments. The 2x latency line needs a source or softer wording. Also recommend adding a short customer quote placeholder.

Elliot (Design): hero image looks good; will produce 2 crop variants and thumbs. Need alt text from copy.

Sam (Growth): adding HubSpot UTM mapping now. Please ensure header CTA goes to webinar + blog. UTM example: `utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=mar2026_product`. Also recommend adding a short lead magnet (webinar) above fold.

Ben (Sales Ops): inbound routing question: what qualifying fields do we want? I'll map Enterprise -> AE queue, Mid-market -> SDR by default. Ping me with exact lead tag values.

Priya (Product): tagging @Tom (CTO) for a 1-2 line technical quote about latency/cost improvements. Tom — can you drop something short we can pull into the hero?

Tom (CTO): Draft quote: "Redwood Inference reduces tail latency while lowering per-token inference cost, letting teams ship responsive LLM features without rearchitecting their stack." Happy to tweak.

LegalBot: Automated scan: flagged phrase 'industry-leading 99% uptime' as 'unverified claim' — please supply substantiation or adjust language.

Ava (Marketing): Thanks — I'll soften to 'SLA-backed uptime targets' and link to infra page. Updated doc and removed the hard 99% stat. Also moved Tom's quote into the hero variants.

Sam (Growth): live UTM snippets added to the doc. For webinar CTA: header CTA -> /register?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=mar2026_webinar. Adding a secondary CTA for demo requests.

Ben (Sales Ops): confirmed routing mapping in the ops doc: Enterprise -> AE-Live; Mid-Market -> Inbound SDR; Demo requests -> DemoOps queue. I added tags: `lead_tier:enterprise|midmarket|demo`.

Elliot (Design): uploaded final hero and thumbnail images to the assets folder, named `hero_variantA.jpg` and `hero_variantB.jpg`. Also added alt text suggestions in the doc.

Ava (Marketing): Great — locking content at 17:30 PT. Will hand off to publishing to schedule. Please add any final nits before then.

LaunchBot: Reminder: publish window reserved for 2026-03-12 13:00 UTC.

Sam (Growth): approved from Growth side. :thumbsup: Minor copy tweak suggested for webinar RSVP button text.

Ben (Sales Ops): routing rules deployed to staging. I'll monitor first-hour leads and report anomalies.

Ava (Marketing): Thanks team — final checklist: legal ok (resolved), CTO quote in hero (done), images uploaded (done), UTMs and routing (done). I'll push to staging and confirm schedule.

LaunchBot: Deploy scheduled: blog-staging -> production at 2026-03-12T13:00:00Z.

Ava (Marketing): Copy locked and pushed to staging. Will reconvene post-publish for performance + lead flow readout.
